comment:
* A media player interface defining traditional high-level functionality, such as the ability to * play, pause, seek and query properties of the currently playing media. * *

This interface includes some convenience methods that can be implemented by calling other * methods in the interface. {@link BasePlayer} implements these convenience methods so inheriting * {@link BasePlayer} is recommended when implementing the interface so that only the minimal set of * required methods can be implemented. * *

Some important properties of media players that implement this interface are: * *

    *
  • They can provide a {@link Timeline} representing the structure of the media being played, * which can be obtained by calling {@link #getCurrentTimeline()}. *
  • They can provide a {@link TracksInfo} defining the currently available tracks and which are * selected to be rendered, which can be obtained by calling {@link #getCurrentTracksInfo()}. *

variables.name: STATE_IDLE
variables.comment:
* The player is idle, meaning it holds only limited resources. The player must be {@link
   * #prepare() prepared} before it will play the media.

variables.name: STATE_BUFFERING
variables.comment:
* The player is not able to immediately play the media, but is doing work toward being able to do
   * so. This state typically occurs when the player needs to buffer more data before playback can
   * start.

variables.name: STATE_READY
variables.comment:
* The player is able to immediately play from its current position. The player will be playing if
   * {@link #getPlayWhenReady()} is true, and paused otherwise.

variables.name: STATE_ENDED
variables.comment: The player has finished playing the media.

variables.name: PLAY_WHEN_READY_CHANGE_REASON_USER_REQUEST
variables.comment: Playback has been started or paused by a call to {@link #setPlayWhenReady(boolean)}.

variables.name: PLAY_WHEN_READY_CHANGE_REASON_AUDIO_FOCUS_LOSS
variables.comment: Playback has been paused because of a loss of audio focus.

variables.name: PLAY_WHEN_READY_CHANGE_REASON_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY
variables.comment: Playback has been paused to avoid becoming noisy.

variables.name: PLAY_WHEN_READY_CHANGE_REASON_REMOTE
variables.comment: Playback has been started or paused because of a remote change.

variables.name: PLAY_WHEN_READY_CHANGE_REASON_END_OF_MEDIA_ITEM
variables.comment: Playback has been paused at the end of a media item.

variables.name: PLAYBACK_SUPPRESSION_REASON_NONE
variables.comment: Playback is not suppressed.

variables.name: PLAYBACK_SUPPRESSION_REASON_TRANSIENT_AUDIO_FOCUS_LOSS
variables.comment: Playback is suppressed due to transient audio focus loss.

variables.name: REPEAT_MODE_OFF
variables.comment:
* Normal playback without repetition. "Previous" and "Next" actions move to the previous and next
   * {@link MediaItem} respectively, and do nothing when there is no previous or next {@link
   * MediaItem} to move to.

variables.name: REPEAT_MODE_ONE
variables.comment:
* Repeats the currently playing {@link MediaItem} infinitely during ongoing playback. "Previous"
   * and "Next" actions behave as they do in {@link #REPEAT_MODE_OFF}, moving to the previous and
   * next {@link MediaItem} respectively, and doing nothing when there is no previous or next {@link
   * MediaItem} to move to.

variables.name: REPEAT_MODE_ALL
variables.comment:
* Repeats the entire timeline infinitely. "Previous" and "Next" actions behave as they do in
   * {@link #REPEAT_MODE_OFF}, but with looping at the ends so that "Previous" when playing the
   * first {@link MediaItem} will move to the last {@link MediaItem}, and "Next" when playing the
   * last {@link MediaItem} will move to the first {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: DISCONTINUITY_REASON_AUTO_TRANSITION
variables.comment:
* Automatic playback transition from one period in the timeline to the next. The period index may * be the same as it was before the discontinuity in case the current period is repeated. * *

This reason also indicates an automatic transition from the content period to an inserted ad * period or vice versa. Or a transition caused by another player (e.g. multiple controllers can * control the same playback on a remote device).

variables.name: DISCONTINUITY_REASON_SEEK
variables.comment: Seek within the current period or to another period.

variables.name: DISCONTINUITY_REASON_SEEK_ADJUSTMENT
variables.comment:
* Seek adjustment due to being unable to seek to the requested position or because the seek was
   * permitted to be inexact.

variables.name: DISCONTINUITY_REASON_SKIP
variables.comment: Discontinuity introduced by a skipped period (for instance a skipped ad).

variables.name: DISCONTINUITY_REASON_REMOVE
variables.comment: Discontinuity caused by the removal of the current period from the {@link Timeline}.

variables.name: DISCONTINUITY_REASON_INTERNAL
variables.comment: Discontinuity introduced internally (e.g. by the source).

variables.name: TIMELINE_CHANGE_REASON_PLAYLIST_CHANGED
variables.comment: Timeline changed as a result of a change of the playlist items or the order of the items.

variables.name: TIMELINE_CHANGE_REASON_SOURCE_UPDATE
variables.comment:
* Timeline changed as a result of a source update (e.g. result of a dynamic update by the played * media). * *

This reason also indicates a change caused by another player (e.g. multiple controllers can * control the same playback on the remote device).

variables.name: MEDIA_ITEM_TRANSITION_REASON_REPEAT
variables.comment: The media item has been repeated.

variables.name: MEDIA_ITEM_TRANSITION_REASON_AUTO
variables.comment:
* Playback has automatically transitioned to the next media item. * *

This reason also indicates a transition caused by another player (e.g. multiple controllers * can control the same playback on a remote device).

variables.name: MEDIA_ITEM_TRANSITION_REASON_SEEK
variables.comment: A seek to another media item has occurred.

variables.name: MEDIA_ITEM_TRANSITION_REASON_PLAYLIST_CHANGED
variables.comment:
* The current media item has changed because of a change in the playlist. This can either be if
   * the media item previously being played has been removed, or when the playlist becomes non-empty
   * after being empty.

variables.name: EVENT_TIMELINE_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getCurrentTimeline()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_MEDIA_ITEM_TRANSITION
variables.comment: {@link #getCurrentMediaItem()} changed or the player started repeating the current item.

variables.name: EVENT_TRACKS_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getCurrentTracksInfo()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_IS_LOADING_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #isLoading()} ()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_PLAYBACK_STATE_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getPlaybackState()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_PLAY_WHEN_READY_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getPlayWhenReady()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_PLAYBACK_SUPPRESSION_REASON_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getPlaybackSuppressionReason()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_IS_PLAYING_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #isPlaying()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_REPEAT_MODE_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getRepeatMode()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_SHUFFLE_MODE_ENABLED_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getShuffleModeEnabled()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_PLAYER_ERROR
variables.comment: {@link #getPlayerError()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_POSITION_DISCONTINUITY
variables.comment:
* A position discontinuity occurred. See {@link Listener#onPositionDiscontinuity(PositionInfo,
   * PositionInfo, int)}.

variables.name: EVENT_PLAYBACK_PARAMETERS_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getPlaybackParameters()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_AVAILABLE_COMMANDS_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #isCommandAvailable(int)} changed for at least one {@link Command}.

variables.name: EVENT_MEDIA_METADATA_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getMediaMetadata()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_PLAYLIST_METADATA_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getPlaylistMetadata()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_SEEK_BACK_INCREMENT_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getSeekBackIncrement()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_SEEK_FORWARD_INCREMENT_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getSeekForwardIncrement()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_MAX_SEEK_TO_PREVIOUS_POSITION_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getMaxSeekToPreviousPosition()} changed.

variables.name: EVENT_TRACK_SELECTION_PARAMETERS_CHANGED
variables.comment: {@link #getTrackSelectionParameters()} changed.

variables.name: COMMAND_PLAY_PAUSE
variables.comment: Command to start, pause or resume playback.

variables.name: COMMAND_PREPARE
variables.comment: Command to prepare the player.

variables.name: COMMAND_STOP
variables.comment: Command to stop playback or release the player.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_TO_DEFAULT_POSITION
variables.comment: Command to seek to the default position of the current {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_IN_CURRENT_MEDIA_ITEM
variables.comment: Command to seek anywhere into the current {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_IN_CURRENT_WINDOW
variables.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #COMMAND_SEEK_IN_CURRENT_MEDIA_ITEM} instead.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_TO_PREVIOUS_MEDIA_ITEM
variables.comment: Command to seek to the default position of the previous {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_TO_PREVIOUS_WINDOW
variables.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #COMMAND_SEEK_TO_PREVIOUS_MEDIA_ITEM} instead.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_TO_PREVIOUS
variables.comment: Command to seek to an earlier position in the current or previous {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_TO_NEXT_MEDIA_ITEM
variables.comment: Command to seek to the default position of the next {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_TO_NEXT_WINDOW
variables.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #COMMAND_SEEK_TO_NEXT_MEDIA_ITEM} instead.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_TO_NEXT
variables.comment: Command to seek to a later position in the current or next {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_TO_MEDIA_ITEM
variables.comment: Command to seek anywhere in any {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_TO_WINDOW
variables.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #COMMAND_SEEK_TO_MEDIA_ITEM} instead.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_BACK
variables.comment: Command to seek back by a fixed increment into the current {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_SEEK_FORWARD
variables.comment: Command to seek forward by a fixed increment into the current {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_SET_SPEED_AND_PITCH
variables.comment: Command to set the playback speed and pitch.

variables.name: COMMAND_SET_SHUFFLE_MODE
variables.comment: Command to enable shuffling.

variables.name: COMMAND_SET_REPEAT_MODE
variables.comment: Command to set the repeat mode.

variables.name: COMMAND_GET_CURRENT_MEDIA_ITEM
variables.comment: Command to get the currently playing {@link MediaItem}.

variables.name: COMMAND_GET_TIMELINE
variables.comment: Command to get the information about the current timeline.

variables.name: COMMAND_GET_MEDIA_ITEMS_METADATA
variables.comment: Command to get the {@link MediaItem MediaItems} metadata.

variables.name: COMMAND_SET_MEDIA_ITEMS_METADATA
variables.comment: Command to set the {@link MediaItem MediaItems} metadata.

variables.name: COMMAND_CHANGE_MEDIA_ITEMS
variables.comment: Command to change the {@link MediaItem MediaItems} in the playlist.

variables.name: COMMAND_GET_AUDIO_ATTRIBUTES
variables.comment: Command to get the player current {@link AudioAttributes}.

variables.name: COMMAND_GET_VOLUME
variables.comment: Command to get the player volume.

variables.name: COMMAND_GET_DEVICE_VOLUME
variables.comment: Command to get the device volume and whether it is muted.

variables.name: COMMAND_SET_VOLUME
variables.comment: Command to set the player volume.

variables.name: COMMAND_SET_DEVICE_VOLUME
variables.comment: Command to set the device volume and mute it.

variables.name: COMMAND_ADJUST_DEVICE_VOLUME
variables.comment: Command to increase and decrease the device volume and mute it.

variables.name: COMMAND_SET_VIDEO_SURFACE
variables.comment: Command to set and clear the surface on which to render the video.

variables.name: COMMAND_GET_TEXT
variables.comment: Command to get the text that should currently be displayed by the player.

variables.name: COMMAND_SET_TRACK_SELECTION_PARAMETERS
variables.comment: Command to set the player's track selection parameters.

variables.name: COMMAND_GET_TRACK_INFOS
variables.comment: Command to get track infos.

variables.name: COMMAND_INVALID
variables.comment: Represents an invalid {@link Command}.

methods.name: Looper getApplicationLooper()
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link Looper} associated with the application thread that's used to access the
   * player and on which player events are received.

methods.name: void addListener(Listener listener)
methods.comment:
* Registers a listener to receive all events from the player. * *

The listener's methods will be called on the thread associated with {@link * #getApplicationLooper()}. * * @param listener The listener to register.

methods.name: void removeListener(Listener listener)
methods.comment:
* Unregister a listener registered through {@link #addListener(Listener)}. The listener will no
   * longer receive events.
   *
   * @param listener The listener to unregister.

methods.name: void setMediaItems(List<MediaItem> mediaItems)
methods.comment:
* Clears the playlist, adds the specified {@link MediaItem MediaItems} and resets the position to
   * the default position.
   *
   * @param mediaItems The new {@link MediaItem MediaItems}.

methods.name: void setMediaItems(List<MediaItem> mediaItems, boolean resetPosition)
methods.comment:
* Clears the playlist and adds the specified {@link MediaItem MediaItems}.
   *
   * @param mediaItems The new {@link MediaItem MediaItems}.
   * @param resetPosition Whether the playback position should be reset to the default position in
   *     the first {@link Timeline.Window}. If false, playback will start from the position defined
   *     by {@link #getCurrentMediaItemIndex()} and {@link #getCurrentPosition()}.

methods.name: void setMediaItems(List<MediaItem> mediaItems, int startIndex, long startPositionMs)
methods.comment:
* Clears the playlist and adds the specified {@link MediaItem MediaItems}.
   *
   * @param mediaItems The new {@link MediaItem MediaItems}.
   * @param startIndex The {@link MediaItem} index to start playback from. If {@link C#INDEX_UNSET}
   *     is passed, the current position is not reset.
   * @param startPositionMs The position in milliseconds to start playback from. If {@link
   *     C#TIME_UNSET} is passed, the default position of the given {@link MediaItem} is used. In
   *     any case, if {@code startIndex} is set to {@link C#INDEX_UNSET}, this parameter is ignored
   *     and the position is not reset at all.
   * @throws IllegalSeekPositionException If the provided {@code startIndex} is not within the
   *     bounds of the list of media items.

methods.name: void setMediaItem(MediaItem mediaItem)
methods.comment:
* Clears the playlist, adds the specified {@link MediaItem} and resets the position to the
   * default position.
   *
   * @param mediaItem The new {@link MediaItem}.

methods.name: void setMediaItem(MediaItem mediaItem, long startPositionMs)
methods.comment:
* Clears the playlist and adds the specified {@link MediaItem}.
   *
   * @param mediaItem The new {@link MediaItem}.
   * @param startPositionMs The position in milliseconds to start playback from.

methods.name: void setMediaItem(MediaItem mediaItem, boolean resetPosition)
methods.comment:
* Clears the playlist and adds the specified {@link MediaItem}.
   *
   * @param mediaItem The new {@link MediaItem}.
   * @param resetPosition Whether the playback position should be reset to the default position. If
   *     false, playback will start from the position defined by {@link #getCurrentMediaItemIndex()}
   *     and {@link #getCurrentPosition()}.

methods.name: void addMediaItem(MediaItem mediaItem)
methods.comment:
* Adds a media item to the end of the playlist.
   *
   * @param mediaItem The {@link MediaItem} to add.

methods.name: void addMediaItem(int index, MediaItem mediaItem)
methods.comment:
* Adds a media item at the given index of the playlist.
   *
   * @param index The index at which to add the media item. If the index is larger than the size of
   *     the playlist, the media item is added to the end of the playlist.
   * @param mediaItem The {@link MediaItem} to add.

methods.name: void addMediaItems(List<MediaItem> mediaItems)
methods.comment:
* Adds a list of media items to the end of the playlist.
   *
   * @param mediaItems The {@link MediaItem MediaItems} to add.

methods.name: void addMediaItems(int index, List<MediaItem> mediaItems)
methods.comment:
* Adds a list of media items at the given index of the playlist.
   *
   * @param index The index at which to add the media items. If the index is larger than the size of
   *     the playlist, the media items are added to the end of the playlist.
   * @param mediaItems The {@link MediaItem MediaItems} to add.

methods.name: void moveMediaItem(int currentIndex, int newIndex)
methods.comment:
* Moves the media item at the current index to the new index.
   *
   * @param currentIndex The current index of the media item to move.
   * @param newIndex The new index of the media item. If the new index is larger than the size of
   *     the playlist the item is moved to the end of the playlist.

methods.name: void moveMediaItems(int fromIndex, int toIndex, int newIndex)
methods.comment:
* Moves the media item range to the new index.
   *
   * @param fromIndex The start of the range to move.
   * @param toIndex The first item not to be included in the range (exclusive).
   * @param newIndex The new index of the first media item of the range. If the new index is larger
   *     than the size of the remaining playlist after removing the range, the range is moved to the
   *     end of the playlist.

methods.name: void removeMediaItem(int index)
methods.comment:
* Removes the media item at the given index of the playlist.
   *
   * @param index The index at which to remove the media item.

methods.name: void removeMediaItems(int fromIndex, int toIndex)
methods.comment:
* Removes a range of media items from the playlist.
   *
   * @param fromIndex The index at which to start removing media items.
   * @param toIndex The index of the first item to be kept (exclusive). If the index is larger than
   *     the size of the playlist, media items to the end of the playlist are removed.

methods.name: void clearMediaItems()
methods.comment: Clears the playlist.

methods.name: boolean isCommandAvailable(@Command int command)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the provided {@link Command} is available. * *

This method does not execute the command. * *

Executing a command that is not available (for example, calling {@link * #seekToNextMediaItem()} if {@link #COMMAND_SEEK_TO_NEXT_MEDIA_ITEM} is unavailable) will * neither throw an exception nor generate a {@link #getPlayerError()} player error}. * *

{@link #COMMAND_SEEK_TO_PREVIOUS_MEDIA_ITEM} and {@link #COMMAND_SEEK_TO_NEXT_MEDIA_ITEM} * are unavailable if there is no such {@link MediaItem}. * * @param command A {@link Command}. * @return Whether the {@link Command} is available. * @see Listener#onAvailableCommandsChanged(Commands)

methods.name: boolean canAdvertiseSession()
methods.comment: Returns whether the player can be used to advertise a media session.

methods.name: Commands getAvailableCommands()
methods.comment:
* Returns the player's currently available {@link Commands}. * *

The returned {@link Commands} are not updated when available commands change. Use {@link * Listener#onAvailableCommandsChanged(Commands)} to get an update when the available commands * change. * *

Executing a command that is not available (for example, calling {@link * #seekToNextMediaItem()} if {@link #COMMAND_SEEK_TO_NEXT_MEDIA_ITEM} is unavailable) will * neither throw an exception nor generate a {@link #getPlayerError()} player error}. * *

{@link #COMMAND_SEEK_TO_PREVIOUS_MEDIA_ITEM} and {@link #COMMAND_SEEK_TO_NEXT_MEDIA_ITEM} * are unavailable if there is no such {@link MediaItem}. * * @return The currently available {@link Commands}. * @see Listener#onAvailableCommandsChanged

methods.name: void prepare()
methods.comment:
* Prepares the player. * *

This will move the player out of {@link #STATE_IDLE idle state} and the player will start * loading media and acquire resources needed for playback.

methods.name: int getPlaybackState()
methods.comment:
* Returns the current {@link State playback state} of the player.
   *
   * @return The current {@link State playback state}.
   * @see Listener#onPlaybackStateChanged(int)

methods.name: int getPlaybackSuppressionReason()
methods.comment:
* Returns the reason why playback is suppressed even though {@link #getPlayWhenReady()} is {@code
   * true}, or {@link #PLAYBACK_SUPPRESSION_REASON_NONE} if playback is not suppressed.
   *
   * @return The current {@link PlaybackSuppressionReason playback suppression reason}.
   * @see Listener#onPlaybackSuppressionReasonChanged(int)

methods.name: boolean isPlaying()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the player is playing, i.e. {@link #getCurrentPosition()} is advancing. * *

If {@code false}, then at least one of the following is true: * *

    *
  • The {@link #getPlaybackState() playback state} is not {@link #STATE_READY ready}. *
  • There is no {@link #getPlayWhenReady() intention to play}. *
  • Playback is {@link #getPlaybackSuppressionReason() suppressed for other reasons}. *
* * @return Whether the player is playing. * @see Listener#onIsPlayingChanged(boolean)

methods.name: PlaybackException getPlayerError()
methods.comment:
* Returns the error that caused playback to fail. This is the same error that will have been * reported via {@link Listener#onPlayerError(PlaybackException)} at the time of failure. It can * be queried using this method until the player is re-prepared. * *

Note that this method will always return {@code null} if {@link #getPlaybackState()} is not * {@link #STATE_IDLE}. * * @return The error, or {@code null}. * @see Listener#onPlayerError(PlaybackException)

methods.name: void play()
methods.comment:
* Resumes playback as soon as {@link #getPlaybackState()} == {@link #STATE_READY}. Equivalent to
   * {@code setPlayWhenReady(true)}.

methods.name: void pause()
methods.comment: Pauses playback. Equivalent to {@code setPlayWhenReady(false)}.

methods.name: void setPlayWhenReady(boolean playWhenReady)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether playback should proceed when {@link #getPlaybackState()} == {@link #STATE_READY}. * *

If the player is already in the ready state then this method pauses and resumes playback. * * @param playWhenReady Whether playback should proceed when ready.

methods.name: boolean getPlayWhenReady()
methods.comment:
* Whether playback will proceed when {@link #getPlaybackState()} == {@link #STATE_READY}.
   *
   * @return Whether playback will proceed when ready.
   * @see Listener#onPlayWhenReadyChanged(boolean, int)

methods.name: void setRepeatMode(@RepeatMode int repeatMode)
methods.comment:
* Sets the {@link RepeatMode} to be used for playback.
   *
   * @param repeatMode The repeat mode.

methods.name: int getRepeatMode()
methods.comment:
* Returns the current {@link RepeatMode} used for playback.
   *
   * @return The current repeat mode.
   * @see Listener#onRepeatModeChanged(int)

methods.name: void setShuffleModeEnabled(boolean shuffleModeEnabled)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether shuffling of media items is enabled.
   *
   * @param shuffleModeEnabled Whether shuffling is enabled.

methods.name: boolean getShuffleModeEnabled()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether shuffling of media items is enabled.
   *
   * @see Listener#onShuffleModeEnabledChanged(boolean)

methods.name: boolean isLoading()
methods.comment:
* Whether the player is currently loading the source.
   *
   * @return Whether the player is currently loading the source.
   * @see Listener#onIsLoadingChanged(boolean)

methods.name: void seekToDefaultPosition()
methods.comment:
* Seeks to the default position associated with the current {@link MediaItem}. The position can
   * depend on the type of media being played. For live streams it will typically be the live edge.
   * For other streams it will typically be the start.

methods.name: void seekToDefaultPosition(int mediaItemIndex)
methods.comment:
* Seeks to the default position associated with the specified {@link MediaItem}. The position can
   * depend on the type of media being played. For live streams it will typically be the live edge.
   * For other streams it will typically be the start.
   *
   * @param mediaItemIndex The index of the {@link MediaItem} whose associated default position
   *     should be seeked to.
   * @throws IllegalSeekPositionException If the player has a non-empty timeline and the provided
   *     {@code mediaItemIndex} is not within the bounds of the current timeline.

methods.name: void seekTo(long positionMs)
methods.comment:
* Seeks to a position specified in milliseconds in the current {@link MediaItem}.
   *
   * @param positionMs The seek position in the current {@link MediaItem}, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET}
   *     to seek to the media item's default position.

methods.name: void seekTo(int mediaItemIndex, long positionMs)
methods.comment:
* Seeks to a position specified in milliseconds in the specified {@link MediaItem}.
   *
   * @param mediaItemIndex The index of the {@link MediaItem}.
   * @param positionMs The seek position in the specified {@link MediaItem}, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET}
   *     to seek to the media item's default position.
   * @throws IllegalSeekPositionException If the player has a non-empty timeline and the provided
   *     {@code mediaItemIndex} is not within the bounds of the current timeline.

methods.name: long getSeekBackIncrement()
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link #seekBack()} increment.
   *
   * @return The seek back increment, in milliseconds.
   * @see Listener#onSeekBackIncrementChanged(long)

methods.name: void seekBack()
methods.comment: * Seeks back in the current {@link MediaItem} by {@link #getSeekBackIncrement()} milliseconds.

methods.name: long getSeekForwardIncrement()
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link #seekForward()} increment.
   *
   * @return The seek forward increment, in milliseconds.
   * @see Listener#onSeekForwardIncrementChanged(long)

methods.name: void seekForward()
methods.comment:
* Seeks forward in the current {@link MediaItem} by {@link #getSeekForwardIncrement()}
   * milliseconds.

methods.name: boolean hasPrevious()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #hasPreviousMediaItem()} instead.

methods.name: boolean hasPreviousWindow()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #hasPreviousMediaItem()} instead.

methods.name: boolean hasPreviousMediaItem()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether a previous media item exists, which may depend on the current repeat mode and * whether shuffle mode is enabled. * *

Note: When the repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE}, this method behaves the same as when * the current repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_OFF}. See {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE} for more * details.

methods.name: void previous()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #seekToPreviousMediaItem()} instead.

methods.name: void seekToPreviousWindow()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #seekToPreviousMediaItem()} instead.

methods.name: void seekToPreviousMediaItem()
methods.comment:
* Seeks to the default position of the previous {@link MediaItem}, which may depend on the * current repeat mode and whether shuffle mode is enabled. Does nothing if {@link * #hasPreviousMediaItem()} is {@code false}. * *

Note: When the repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE}, this method behaves the same as when * the current repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_OFF}. See {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE} for more * details.

methods.name: long getMaxSeekToPreviousPosition()
methods.comment:
* Returns the maximum position for which {@link #seekToPrevious()} seeks to the previous {@link
   * MediaItem}, in milliseconds.
   *
   * @return The maximum seek to previous position, in milliseconds.
   * @see Listener#onMaxSeekToPreviousPositionChanged(long)

methods.name: void seekToPrevious()
methods.comment:
* Seeks to an earlier position in the current or previous {@link MediaItem} (if available). More * precisely: * *
    *
  • If the timeline is empty or seeking is not possible, does nothing. *
  • Otherwise, if the current {@link MediaItem} is {@link #isCurrentMediaItemLive()} live} * and {@link #isCurrentMediaItemSeekable() unseekable}, then: *
      *
    • If {@link #hasPreviousMediaItem() a previous media item exists}, seeks to the * default position of the previous media item. *
    • Otherwise, does nothing. *
    *
  • Otherwise, if {@link #hasPreviousMediaItem() a previous media item exists} and the {@link * #getCurrentPosition() current position} is less than {@link * #getMaxSeekToPreviousPosition()}, seeks to the default position of the previous {@link * MediaItem}. *
  • Otherwise, seeks to 0 in the current {@link MediaItem}. *

methods.name: boolean hasNext()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #hasNextMediaItem()} instead.

methods.name: boolean hasNextWindow()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #hasNextMediaItem()} instead.

methods.name: boolean hasNextMediaItem()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether a next {@link MediaItem} exists, which may depend on the current repeat mode * and whether shuffle mode is enabled. * *

Note: When the repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE}, this method behaves the same as when * the current repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_OFF}. See {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE} for more * details.

methods.name: void next()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #seekToNextMediaItem()} instead.

methods.name: void seekToNextWindow()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #seekToNextMediaItem()} instead.

methods.name: void seekToNextMediaItem()
methods.comment:
* Seeks to the default position of the next {@link MediaItem}, which may depend on the current * repeat mode and whether shuffle mode is enabled. Does nothing if {@link #hasNextMediaItem()} is * {@code false}. * *

Note: When the repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE}, this method behaves the same as when * the current repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_OFF}. See {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE} for more * details.

methods.name: void seekToNext()
methods.comment:
* Seeks to a later position in the current or next {@link MediaItem} (if available). More * precisely: * *
    *
  • If the timeline is empty or seeking is not possible, does nothing. *
  • Otherwise, if {@link #hasNextMediaItem() a next media item exists}, seeks to the default * position of the next {@link MediaItem}. *
  • Otherwise, if the current {@link MediaItem} is {@link #isCurrentMediaItemLive() live} and * has not ended, seeks to the live edge of the current {@link MediaItem}. *
  • Otherwise, does nothing. *

methods.name: void setPlaybackParameters(PlaybackParameters playbackParameters)
methods.comment:
* Attempts to set the playback parameters. Passing {@link PlaybackParameters#DEFAULT} resets the * player to the default, which means there is no speed or pitch adjustment. * *

Playback parameters changes may cause the player to buffer. {@link * Listener#onPlaybackParametersChanged(PlaybackParameters)} will be called whenever the currently * active playback parameters change. * * @param playbackParameters The playback parameters.

methods.name: void setPlaybackSpeed(@FloatRange(from = 0, fromInclusive = false) float speed)
methods.comment:
* Changes the rate at which playback occurs. The pitch is not changed. * *

This is equivalent to {@code * setPlaybackParameters(getPlaybackParameters().withSpeed(speed))}. * * @param speed The linear factor by which playback will be sped up. Must be higher than 0. 1 is * normal speed, 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 is half normal speed...

methods.name: PlaybackParameters getPlaybackParameters()
methods.comment:
* Returns the currently active playback parameters.
   *
   * @see Listener#onPlaybackParametersChanged(PlaybackParameters)

methods.name: void stop()
methods.comment:
* Stops playback without resetting the playlist. Use {@link #pause()} rather than this method if * the intention is to pause playback. * *

Calling this method will cause the playback state to transition to {@link #STATE_IDLE} and * the player will release the loaded media and resources required for playback. The player * instance can still be used by calling {@link #prepare()} again, and {@link #release()} must * still be called on the player if it's no longer required. * *

Calling this method does not clear the playlist, reset the playback position or the playback * error.

methods.name: void stop(boolean reset)
methods.comment:
* @deprecated Use {@link #stop()} and {@link #clearMediaItems()} (if {@code reset} is true) or
   *     just {@link #stop()} (if {@code reset} is false). Any player error will be cleared when
   *     {@link #prepare() re-preparing} the player.

methods.name: void release()
methods.comment:
* Releases the player. This method must be called when the player is no longer required. The
   * player must not be used after calling this method.

methods.comment:

   * @deprecated Use {@link #getCurrentTracksInfo()}.

methods.name: TrackSelectionArray getCurrentTrackSelections()
methods.comment:
* Returns the current track selections. * *

A concrete implementation may include null elements if it has a fixed number of renderer * components, wishes to report a TrackSelection for each of them, and has one or more renderer * components that is not assigned any selected tracks. * * @see Listener#onTracksChanged(TrackGroupArray, TrackSelectionArray) * @deprecated Use {@link #getCurrentTracksInfo()}.

methods.name: TracksInfo getCurrentTracksInfo()
methods.comment:
* Returns the available tracks, as well as the tracks' support, type, and selection status.
   *
   * @see Listener#onTracksChanged(TrackGroupArray, TrackSelectionArray)

methods.name: TrackSelectionParameters getTrackSelectionParameters()
void setTrackSelectionParameters(TrackSelectionParameters parameters)
methods.comment:
* Sets the parameters constraining the track selection. * *

Unsupported parameters will be silently ignored. * *

Use {@link #getTrackSelectionParameters()} to retrieve the current parameters. For example, * the following snippet restricts video to SD whilst keep other track selection parameters * unchanged: * * 

{@code
   * player.setTrackSelectionParameters(
   *   player.getTrackSelectionParameters()
   *         .buildUpon()
   *         .setMaxVideoSizeSd()
   *         .build())
   * }

methods.name: MediaMetadata getMediaMetadata()
methods.comment:
* Returns the current combined {@link MediaMetadata}, or {@link MediaMetadata#EMPTY} if not * supported. * *

This {@link MediaMetadata} is a combination of the {@link MediaItem#mediaMetadata} and the * static and dynamic metadata from the {@link TrackSelection#getFormat(int) track selections' * formats} and {@link Listener#onMetadata(Metadata)}. If a field is populated in the {@link * MediaItem#mediaMetadata}, it will be prioritised above the same field coming from static or * dynamic metadata.

methods.name: MediaMetadata getPlaylistMetadata()
methods.comment:
* Returns the playlist {@link MediaMetadata}, as set by {@link

methods.name: void setPlaylistMetadata(MediaMetadata mediaMetadata)
methods.comment: Sets the playlist {@link MediaMetadata}.

   * @see Listener#onTimelineChanged(Timeline, int)

methods.name: int getCurrentPeriodIndex()

   * timeline}, or the prospective index if the {@link #getCurrentTimeline() current timeline} is

methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the {@link MediaItem} that will be played if {@link * #seekToNextMediaItem()} is called, which may depend on the current repeat mode and whether * shuffle mode is enabled. Returns {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} if {@link #hasNextMediaItem()} is {@code * false}. * *

Note: When the repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE}, this method behaves the same as when * the current repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_OFF}. See {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE} for more * details.

methods.name: int getPreviousWindowIndex()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #getPreviousMediaItemIndex()} instead.

* Returns the index of the {@link MediaItem} that will be played if {@link * #seekToPreviousMediaItem()} is called, which may depend on the current repeat mode and whether * shuffle mode is enabled. Returns {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} if {@link #hasPreviousMediaItem()} is * {@code false}. * *

Note: When the repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE}, this method behaves the same as when * the current repeat mode is {@link #REPEAT_MODE_OFF}. See {@link #REPEAT_MODE_ONE} for more * details.

methods.name: MediaItem getCurrentMediaItem()
methods.comment:
* Returns the currently playing {@link MediaItem}. May be null if the timeline is empty.
   *
   * @see Listener#onMediaItemTransition(MediaItem, int)

methods.name: int getMediaItemCount()
methods.comment: Returns the number of {@link MediaItem media items} in the playlist.

methods.name: MediaItem getMediaItemAt(int index)
methods.comment: Returns the {@link MediaItem} at the given index.

methods.name: long getDuration()
methods.comment:
* Returns the duration of the current content or ad in milliseconds, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if
   * the duration is not known.

methods.name: long getCurrentPosition()
methods.comment:
* Returns the playback position in the current content or ad, in milliseconds, or the prospective
   * position in milliseconds if the {@link #getCurrentTimeline() current timeline} is empty.

methods.name: long getBufferedPosition()
methods.comment:
* Returns an estimate of the position in the current content or ad up to which data is buffered,
   * in milliseconds.

methods.name: int getBufferedPercentage()
methods.comment:
* Returns an estimate of the percentage in the current content or ad up to which data is
   * buffered, or 0 if no estimate is available.

methods.name: long getTotalBufferedDuration()
methods.comment:
* Returns an estimate of the total buffered duration from the current position, in milliseconds.
   * This includes pre-buffered data for subsequent ads and {@link MediaItem media items}.

methods.name: boolean isCurrentWindowDynamic()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #isCurrentMediaItemDynamic()} instead.

methods.name: boolean isCurrentMediaItemDynamic()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the current {@link MediaItem} is dynamic (may change when the {@link Timeline}
   * is updated), or {@code false} if the {@link Timeline} is empty.
   *
   * @see Timeline.Window#isDynamic

methods.name: boolean isCurrentWindowLive()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #isCurrentMediaItemLive()} instead.

methods.name: boolean isCurrentMediaItemLive()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the current {@link MediaItem} is live, or {@code false} if the {@link Timeline}
   * is empty.
   *
   * @see Timeline.Window#isLive()

methods.name: long getCurrentLiveOffset()
methods.comment:
* Returns the offset of the current playback position from the live edge in milliseconds, or * {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if the current {@link MediaItem} {@link #isCurrentMediaItemLive()} isn't * live} or the offset is unknown. * *

The offset is calculated as {@code currentTime - playbackPosition}, so should usually be * positive. * *

Note that this offset may rely on an accurate local time, so this method may return an * incorrect value if the difference between system clock and server clock is unknown.

methods.name: boolean isCurrentWindowSeekable()
methods.comment: @deprecated Use {@link #isCurrentMediaItemSeekable()} instead.

methods.name: boolean isCurrentMediaItemSeekable()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the current {@link MediaItem} is seekable, or {@code false} if the {@link
   * Timeline} is empty.
   *
   * @see Timeline.Window#isSeekable

methods.name: boolean isPlayingAd()
methods.comment: Returns whether the player is currently playing an ad.

methods.name: int getCurrentAdGroupIndex()
methods.comment:
* If {@link #isPlayingAd()} returns true, returns the index of the ad group in the period
   * currently being played. Returns {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} otherwise.

methods.name: int getCurrentAdIndexInAdGroup()
methods.comment:
* If {@link #isPlayingAd()} returns true, returns the index of the ad in its ad group. Returns
   * {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} otherwise.

methods.name: long getContentDuration()
methods.comment:
* If {@link #isPlayingAd()} returns {@code true}, returns the duration of the current content in
   * milliseconds, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if the duration is not known. If there is no ad playing,
   * the returned duration is the same as that returned by {@link #getDuration()}.

methods.name: long getContentPosition()
methods.comment:
* If {@link #isPlayingAd()} returns {@code true}, returns the content position that will be
   * played once all ads in the ad group have finished playing, in milliseconds. If there is no ad
   * playing, the returned position is the same as that returned by {@link #getCurrentPosition()}.

methods.name: long getContentBufferedPosition()
methods.comment:
* If {@link #isPlayingAd()} returns {@code true}, returns an estimate of the content position in
   * the current content up to which data is buffered, in milliseconds. If there is no ad playing,
   * the returned position is the same as that returned by {@link #getBufferedPosition()}.

methods.name: AudioAttributes getAudioAttributes()

   *

methods.name: void clearVideoSurface()
methods.comment:
* Clears any {@link Surface}, {@link SurfaceHolder}, {@link SurfaceView} or {@link TextureView}
   * currently set on the player.

methods.name: void clearVideoSurface(@Nullable Surface surface)
methods.comment:
* Clears the {@link Surface} onto which video is being rendered if it matches the one passed.
   * Else does nothing.
   *
   * @param surface The surface to clear.

methods.name: void setVideoSurface(@Nullable Surface surface)
methods.comment:
* Sets the {@link Surface} onto which video will be rendered. The caller is responsible for * tracking the lifecycle of the surface, and must clear the surface by calling {@code * setVideoSurface(null)} if the surface is destroyed. * *

If the surface is held by a {@link SurfaceView}, {@link TextureView} or {@link * SurfaceHolder} then it's recommended to use {@link #setVideoSurfaceView(SurfaceView)}, {@link * #setVideoTextureView(TextureView)} or {@link #setVideoSurfaceHolder(SurfaceHolder)} rather than * this method, since passing the holder allows the player to track the lifecycle of the surface * automatically. * * @param surface The {@link Surface}.

methods.name: void setVideoSurfaceHolder(@Nullable SurfaceHolder surfaceHolder)
methods.comment:
* Sets the {@link SurfaceHolder} that holds the {@link Surface} onto which video will be * rendered. The player will track the lifecycle of the surface automatically. * *

The thread that calls the {@link SurfaceHolder.Callback} methods must be the thread * associated with {@link #getApplicationLooper()}. * * @param surfaceHolder The surface holder.

methods.name: void clearVideoSurfaceHolder(@Nullable SurfaceHolder surfaceHolder)
methods.comment:
* Clears the {@link SurfaceHolder} that holds the {@link Surface} onto which video is being
   * rendered if it matches the one passed. Else does nothing.
   *
   * @param surfaceHolder The surface holder to clear.

methods.name: void setVideoSurfaceView(@Nullable SurfaceView surfaceView)
methods.comment:
* Sets the {@link SurfaceView} onto which video will be rendered. The player will track the * lifecycle of the surface automatically. * *

The thread that calls the {@link SurfaceHolder.Callback} methods must be the thread * associated with {@link #getApplicationLooper()}. * * @param surfaceView The surface view.

methods.name: void clearVideoSurfaceView(@Nullable SurfaceView surfaceView)
methods.comment:
* Clears the {@link SurfaceView} onto which video is being rendered if it matches the one passed.
   * Else does nothing.
   *
   * @param surfaceView The texture view to clear.

methods.name: void setVideoTextureView(@Nullable TextureView textureView)
methods.comment:
* Sets the {@link TextureView} onto which video will be rendered. The player will track the * lifecycle of the surface automatically. * *

The thread that calls the {@link TextureView.SurfaceTextureListener} methods must be the * thread associated with {@link #getApplicationLooper()}. * * @param textureView The texture view.

methods.name: void clearVideoTextureView(@Nullable TextureView textureView)
methods.comment:
* Clears the {@link TextureView} onto which video is being rendered if it matches the one passed.
   * Else does nothing.
   *
   * @param textureView The texture view to clear.

The video's width and height are {@code 0} if there is no video or its size has not been * determined yet. * * @see Listener#onVideoSizeChanged(VideoSize)

For devices with {@link DeviceInfo#PLAYBACK_TYPE_LOCAL local playback}, the volume returned * by this method varies according to the current {@link C.StreamType stream type}. The stream * type is determined by {@link AudioAttributes#usage} which can be converted to stream type with * {@link Util#getStreamTypeForAudioUsage(int)}. * *

For devices with {@link DeviceInfo#PLAYBACK_TYPE_REMOTE remote playback}, the volume of the * remote device is returned.
